reasoning_content: The sessions controller is standard Devise. Let me find where devise is being included in the User model — searching for "devise" case-insensitively across the entire model.

action.command: cd /workspace && grep -rn "devise" app/models/user.rb | head; echo "=== find devise declaration anywhere ==="; grep -rn "devise :" app/models/ | head; grep -rn "include Devise\|devise" app/models/concerns/verification.rb 2>/dev/null | head -5
